note: 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden on PlayStation until earned; 0 online trophies; all earnable in one playthrough. Names, descriptions and grades are exactly as PlayStation publishes them (via Exophase and PSNProfiles). Guides are written for this entry in our own words; each cites its sources.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List
Vice City Hustle — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: No separate task: it unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. Single-player only, no online requirement and no DLC involved. Budget roughly 200 hours for the full road at difficulty 4/10.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Opening mission Gone Fishing, Chapter 1. Play the intro through; the trophy lands when the mission wraps up. Unmissable.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Clear Chapter 1; it pops as Chapter 2's first main mission, What's in the Bag?, begins.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Clear Chapter 2; it pops when Chapter 3 opens with Welcome to Vice City.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Clear Chapter 3; it pops after Chapter 4's first two main missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Clear Chapter 4; it pops after the chapter's final main mission, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the campaign's final mission. Gold, automatic, story only — the last beat of the campaign.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play Chapter 2's main mission Breakfast Run to the end. Story trophy, unmissable.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Play Chapter 3's main mission The Cartel Heist to the end. Story trophy, unmissable.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Play Chapter 4's main mission Child's Play to the end. Story trophy, unmissable.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Play Chapter 4's main mission Headliners to the end. Story trophy, unmissable.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Play Chapter 4's main mission VCIA Takedown to the end. Story trophy, unmissable.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Play Chapter 5's main mission Operation Savage Glory to the end. Story trophy, unmissable.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story. The bar is forgiving — nearer 60% true completion: for example 100 optional missions, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied and 300 of 397 stunts. Story progress already counts, and nothing on the list is missable — free-roam after the story covers it all. This is the long grind of Step 2, about 100 hours.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Under-the-bridges are the fastest. Progress by region sits under Progress > Activities > Stunts and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. The 100% list wants 300.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball hoops, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and pulling off a stunt. Check them under Touchpad > Progress > Activities; most happen on their own while chasing other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. The golds are manageable, and all 42 feed the 100% checklist, so treat this as core Step 2 work rather than a side errand.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations (42 drone races in total). The 100% checklist also wants all 42 drone time trials done, so fold this into Step 2.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Leonida holds 40 unique race locations, and the 100% checklist wants 30 wins, so this lands on the way to A Long Road.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After Chapter 1's Feng Shui, when you meet Cal, he texts a fishing spot marked purple on the map west of Key Lento. Head there, take his fishing challenge, and out-fish him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one of the 4 arcade games end to end: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home from Chapter 1, or Bang For Your Buck at arcade machines around the map. Clear every level of one game; its side challenges are not needed.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia-only. In Chapter 3, as Lucia, Andy calls and then texts her home address, marking the line in Belville. Run her 5 quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass. Still open after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's line opens automatically in Chapter 1 after Island Dreams. He marks treasure chests (purple icons); dive the shipwrecks with the metal detector and haul the treasure back — 7 wrecks in all. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2-3; phoning Brian as Jason hurries it along. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's line opens after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Run his 5 quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, Hometown Heroes. Still open after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying Strangers & Freaks strands. Careful: several optional lines do NOT count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie are not strangers for this trophy. Counted strands include Kirk (Skunk Ape hunts), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries). All findable in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, where you lift the Zorrusso with the Key Cloner. Deliver the 16 sports cars he wants (track them under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; scan cars with WAiNK to check). Good condition pays better. Still open after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After Chapter 3's Here, Kitty Kitty, purple markers flag Synthetic Labs around Vice City — wreck them in Take Out Kitty Litter, then Tyrone hands you Spin On This to shut the labs down for good. Still open after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; both Jason and Lucia meditating at one spot counts as +2. Track under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. POSSIBLY MISSABLE — UNCONFIRMED: the first meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and pick Accept. It is not confirmed whether that first session counts toward the trophy (it raises the counter but is not marked as a Meditation Spot), so do it in Chapter 1 to be safe. The 100% list needs only 15 of 18.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's line, Jason-only, opens after Chapter 2's Coffee Break via text; first quest Veteran Hunted is in Lummox County. He loans you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 (grab it back from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker). Hunt the animals he asks for and bring them in. Track under Map > Activities > Target Deck — 15 Target Decks exist and the 100% list wants all 15. Which exact animal triggers the trophy is still being pinned down.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Finish 3 collectible card sets. 18 card set locations exist in total and the 100% list wants 15 of 18, so this silver lands well before the card hunt ends.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK-scan 100 locations: hold Up then R1 to scan things in the world. Any 100 count, across 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags — there are more than 100 out there, so scan what you pass.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Clear any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% list wants 70 of 80, so this pops on the way. Track them under Progress > Challenges; leave it late, then mop up the easiest leftovers — plenty finish on their own while chasing other trophies.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Earliest after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, once you can free-roam with your partner (hold Right + Triangle to call them). Build a 4-star wanted level, then break out of the red heat zone — a fast sports bike helps, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a handy escape since cops and helicopters struggle to follow. It also pops on its own during the Chapter 4 bank-vault robberies, which always draw 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break, with your partner at your side, rob 3 shops in a row without letting your wanted level clear between them. Loot a couple of items per shop and crack the safe with sticky bombs; the pop comes about 30 seconds after you leave the 3rd shop. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City work well (after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs). If it doesn't pop, hit a 4th shop and keep going.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scan traffic with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1) on a busy road — scanning is enough, no need to drive them. 557 vehicles exist at launch; the 100% list wants 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this pops on its own. Totals sit under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies in a single Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming). Stretch focus with food, drinks or Adrenaline (hold L1 + Triangle), wear body armor from Ammu-Nation, and use an assault rifle like the Duke 556 at a gang operation. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — it gets easier late. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a big passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA — one hooked to a boarding bridge, not the planes parked out on the airfield. Easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, use the stairs by the boarding bridge, head upstairs to the cockpit, reverse onto the runway and take off. Fly 1 km (0.6 miles) clear of the airport for the pop.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — the tanks sit in the south of the base. Slip in through the gate or over the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and start shooting until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun and jewelry store robberies. Slip into a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it in (the gadget stays in your inventory). In the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and kill the alarm, then walk out — it pops soon after. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. They open in Chapter 4's optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault stands open (bring your partner and hold Right to hand off one bag). After that, buy van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 each. 8 large bank jobs exist and the 100% list wants all 8, so this pops on its own. A vault robbery instantly draws 4 stars — escape on a fast bike, then swap vehicles to shake the heat. A vault can pay up to $205,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the red heat radius. The Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… counts on its own, since tailing the truck to a bank vault counts as a truck robbery. Earlier route: block a truck driving near banks in Vice City, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it open — sticky bombs sit in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Unfog the whole map — explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Fastest by plane: fly over every black-fogged patch until the map is fully visible.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. 39 illegal gang operations exist in total and the 100% list wants all 39, so this pops on its own. Operations show as yellow icons on the map when you get close, and many are marked through story progress. Track per gang under Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini and drink it standing by the bar with the view. The exact trigger is still being pinned down by some guides, but PowerPyx ties it to the rooftop bar and the Apple Martini.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City — only possible once you have the Key Cloner from Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs — and drive it straight through the showroom window. The pop is slightly delayed and lands after you drive further down the street. It only works with this blue Banshee, a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (a gang operation, marked during Chapter 2's optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling), steal all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office — blow it with sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation. It pops after you escape the police. Miss one and the robbery icon respawns later, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. After Coffee Break you can switch between characters; train at fitness clubs (filter Map > Activities) and always bring your partner (hold Right + Triangle) — while one trains, the other finishes their training automatically, doubling progress. You can also train at home after the story. Check Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Rack up 500 actions that shape your criminal profile (click the trophy in the trophy list to see the count). Switch on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications) so a demon-face icon flashes whenever an action counts. Robberies and enemy encounters all count and it builds passively while chasing other trophies. Short at the end? Farm it by running over civilians and cops — but note that Psycho or Irredeemable profiles make cops shoot on sight.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED. PowerPyx links it to the Payday Loans store from the prologue (in Little Cuba, Vice City), possibly robbing it again later in a particular way. No reliable method is confirmed yet — KeenGamer likewise lists it as a hidden trophy with an unconfirmed unlock. Do not trust unverified claims for this one; re-check the cited guides before trying anything.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Finish the UFO easter egg: at night after 2 AM, alone, on the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and return. Follow the path into the woods from the car to find the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky), walk up to it, talk to the woman it drops off and help her back to her car. The spawn is slightly random, not guaranteed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Try a crowded stretch like Vice City or Ocean Beach, where pedestrians are dense enough to chain 10 kicks in a minute.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts (fences). First finish Chapter 3's Credit Check (meet Raul's crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays best. It counts cumulatively, not $250,000 at once. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in one robbery, so this comes naturally with the robbery grind.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest route since they are the priciest items. Any shop type counts toward the total.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages ($160,000 total). They open up after Chapter 2's Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone — buy through the app. Fund them with robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4. The 4 story-related garages do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, installed on your phone after Chapter 2's Moses mission. Buy enough garages first — each adds parking spots. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3, standard-tracker cars can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
